note: Yellowstone NP campground beside Slough Creek on the Northern Range, at the end of a 2-mile dirt road off the Northeast Entrance Road, 5.5 mi E of Tower-Roosevelt Junction; Slough Creek Trail starts nearby. The NPS calls it best suited for tents and small RVs. Generator-free. --Claude
summary: NPS record + recreation.gov 259310: 16 reservable non-electric sites (no FCFS), $20 2026/2027, park recommends no vehicle over 25 ft (12 sites list 24 ft+), seasonal vault toilets + hand-pump water, Jun 15-Oct 11. Slough Creek is ~22-27 m wide at the sites -> recommend riverfront -> creekside (sites 4-7 ~20 m over open ground). Pin ~490 m off -> move.
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend riverfront -> creekside): on a zoom-19 Esri tile the wet channel of Slough Creek beside the east loop measures ~22-27 m across (gravel bars excluded), under the ~30 m river line. Sites 4 (44.94902,-110.30747), 5 (44.94911,-110.30762), 6 (44.94914,-110.30779) and 7 (44.94916,-110.30796) sit ~20-25 m from the south bank over open bare ground and grass with a few small trees; all are sold by the night on recreation.gov (site 6 is limited to 20 ft; 4, 5 = 30 ft, 7 = 60 ft). The west loop (8-16) is ~80 m+ back behind a conifer band. recreation.gov tags 1-7, 9-11 'Riverfront'.

PIN MOVE (~490 m): stored 44.9443,-110.3117 is south of the campground on the access road area; the catalog centroid is 44.94830,-110.30904 (east loop around 44.9490,-110.3070, west loop around 44.9477,-110.3107). Suggested pin 44.9483,-110.3090.

RIG FIT (not a drop): recreation.gov notice 'very tight turnaround - vehicles longer than 25 ft (7.6 m) are not recommended'; NPS 'best suited for tents and small RVs'. A 23-ft rig is within the 25-ft line; 12 of 16 sites list 24 ft or more. NPS rvInfo says '14 sites at 30 feet'. max_rig_ft written as the 25-ft recommendation.
Phone: empty -> 307-344-2289 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (307) 344-2289'); the park's general line in the NPS record is 307-344-7381.

Stored note's 'some sites to ~30 ft combined' replaced with the sourced per-site limits; 'Reservable online', toilets and hookups dropped (fields). Stored inclusion_evidence ('RVs to ~25-30 ft') is consistent.

NPS alert (2026-10-29): most park roads closed for winter; the North-Northeast entrance road, which serves this campground, is the only road open year-round. Campground itself closed for the season since Oct 12.
